text:
alex.t: getting 401 invalid_api_key when hitting /v1/chat. Worked yesterday, nothing changed in code. curl below (key masked):
```bash
curl -i https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-••••••••••••••' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-1","input":"hi"}'
```
jen_support: thanks — can you paste the exact header value you copied (masked is fine, but copy-paste the string length and any visible hyphens)? also which macOS app did you copy from (Keychain/accessibility/autofill)?
alex.t: copied from Keychain Access -> right-click -> Copy Password. The value shows like `sk-abcde-12345-fghij` in my notes. length ~32.
sam_ops: checking auth logs for that org now. if you can repro, try a direct pbpaste check to see hidden chars: `pbpaste | od -An -t x1` (should show ascii bytes for letters/digits).
alex.t: ran `pbpaste | od -An -t x1` and saw: `73 6b 2d 61 62 63 64 65 c2 ad 31 32 33 34 35` — there's an extra `c2 ad` in the middle. wtf.
jen_support: that `c2 ad` byte sequence is UTF-8 for a soft hyphen (U+00AD). macOS Keychain autofill/copy sometimes inserts soft hyphens for line-break hints. The API treats them as part of the key so it fails.
sam_ops: server-side shows an auth failure for the exact literal string with the soft hyphen, so 401 is expected.
jen_support: quick repro steps for others: 1) Copy key from Keychain. 2) `pbpaste | od -An -t x1` — if you see `c2 ad` anywhere, your clipboard has a soft hyphen. 3) Remove it locally: `pbpaste | perl -C -pe 's/\x{00AD}//g' | pbcopy` (this strips soft hyphens and writes back to clipboard). 4) Retry curl.
alex.t: ran the perl fix and retried — ✅ request succeeded. Thanks!!
jen_support: long-term: prefer Dashboard copy button or CLI `redwood secrets get-key` (avoid GUI Keychain copy path). We'll add a KB note. filing internal ticket #SUP-1289 to add a short doc and a small warning in Keychain-related docs.
deploy-bot: ticket SUP-1289 created and assigned to docs.
jen_support: if you already rotated the key because of retries, we've revoked the old one and issued a new key. Confirm if you want the old key restored (not recommended).
alex.t: no restore needed. leaving new key in dashboard and will avoid Keychain copy. :thumbsup:
jen_support: glad it's fixed. marking this thread resolved; if anyone else hits similar issues search for "soft hyphen" or ticket SUP-1289.
